title: Cloud Sync
subtitle: Google Drive · selected folders
noTasks: Add a folder pair to start syncing.
welcomeBody: Add multiple accounts and choose a folder pair for each task.
sleep: Idle checks contact the cloud; local folders are scanned at startup and when changes require synchronization.
accountHelp: Authorize on your computer, then import the private authorization file.
driveAccountHelp: Select a linked Google account and grant Drive access.
noLinkedAccounts: No linked Google accounts. Add one in Settings → Connected accounts.
taskHelp: Choose existing folders. Files are accessed using your Linux user permissions.
helperHint: Run this command on your computer with Python 3 and rclone installed. The helper opens the provider login and creates a private JSON file. Do not share this file.
bothHelp: For initial two-way sync, one folder must be empty. Later deletions propagate in both directions; large deletion batches stop the task. Conflicting versions are preserved.
copyHelp: This prototype copies new and changed files without propagating deletions. Replaced destination files are kept in .panasms-cloud-versions.
preserveFiles: Your local and cloud files will be preserved.
server0: Transfer stopped; review the task before resuming.
server1: Cloud operation failed. Check account access, folder availability and quota; reconnect if necessary.
server2: Account authorization expired or access was denied. Reconnect the account.
server3: Cloud change cursor expired. Reconnect the account to rebuild it.
server5: Cloud rate limit reached. Checks will resume with backoff.
server6: Local volume changed or is unavailable; reconnect the original volume
server7: Local volume changed or is unavailable
server9: Local folder must exist and be writable by your Linux user
server10: Local sync folders must not overlap
server11: Cloud sync folders must not overlap
server12: For the first two-way sync, one folder must be empty. Use a new folder to avoid initial conflicts.
server13: Use a local Linux filesystem; network mounts and removable FAT/NTFS are not supported in this prototype.
server14: Reconnect using the same cloud account
server15: Remove tasks before disconnecting this account
server16: Pause the task and wait for the transfer to stop
server17: A transfer is running. Pause it before changing connections or browsing cloud folders.
server22: Task removed; local and cloud files preserved
server24: Safety check stopped the task: too many files changed or were deleted. Review both folders before retrying.
server25: Two-way sync history requires recovery. Preserve both folders and create a new task with an empty destination; automatic reset is disabled.
goServer0: Reconnect this account to grant Drive access
goServer1: Drive access is unavailable. Reconnect this account or restore its permission.
goServer2: Cloud access service is unavailable; retrying later.
goServer3: Cloud Sync operation failed. Check the connection and try again.
goServer4: Task is unavailable or still running. Pause it and wait for the transfer to stop.
goServer5: This cloud account is already connected. Reconnect the existing connection.
goServer6: Cannot monitor local files; check folder permissions.
goServer7: Local watch limit reached; increase inotify limits before resuming
goServer8: Filesystem event queue overflowed. Resume tasks to rebuild monitoring.
goServer9: This permission is read-only. Authorize full Drive access before uploading.
goServer10: Enable Google Drive API in the NAS Google Cloud project, then reconnect this account.
wizardHelp: Choose an account, select both folders and review before starting.
connectionOnly: Connecting an account does not start synchronization.
optionalName: Optional — uses the local folder name
folderServer1: Choose an accessible local folder without symlinks
folderServer3: Cannot create folder. Check permissions and whether the name already exists.
unavailableVolume: Unavailable for Cloud Sync. Choose a local Linux data volume or your home folder.
